Dream 2026-11-22 linked 18 vignettes from 9 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-22 · retells · "Decisions need to be recognised for the type of decision they make and then formed appropriately" (Decisions formed correctly, a taxonomy through practice (2026-10-22))
- 2026-10-22 · touches · "Decisions should generally be scoped to a context." (Decisions are scoped to a context (2026-10-22))
- 2026-10-22 · touches · "these 8 different types should become stable definitions of the forms decisions can take" (Vertices, options, and two trigrams: context and action (2026-10-22))
- 2026-10-24 · touches · "Humans and agents work togetehr on principles and standards." (Who holds which layer: agents at implementation, together at principles (2026-10-24))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "Affirmation is its own layer" (Affirmation is its own layer; in chat it is a fake decision (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "The current affirmation process still seems to regularly result in lost work." (Affirmation comes after the context is lost (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-27 · touches · "The point of principles is to keep moving things forward and to maintain consistency." (Principles keep work moving and consistent; decisions one at a time undermine integrity (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "How do we keep having decisions stay drafts?" (How do decisions keep staying drafts? The same decision comes back, lost in proposals that never reach a session (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "Where do decisions go? When do they stop?" (Where do decisions go, and when do they stop? Many vanished once principles were reviewed (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "Decisions are relevant in the domains where they are relevant." (A decision removes future choices only at the right level; out of context it is noise (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "actively detecting the nested and parallel domains where decisions are relevant" (Sense the nested and parallel domains decisions belong to; keep watching, merge from experience (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "If possible our decision should state why we chose a path." (Vignette 2026-10-30: the first iteration of a registry, lock down only the smallest piece)
- 2026-11-03 · touches · "I need to be able to get the compass used properly to manage decisions." (A clear path from the compass is recorded, not escalated; decisions need an active review process (2026-11-03))
- 2026-11-03 · touches · "A decision needs to present a case for any option, after reviewing past decisions and principles." (Setting up work takes longer than the work; decisions need a case, not a branch (2026-11-03))
- 2026-11-05 · touches · "how we present decisions" (Owner: present decisions with what is relevant in their context; incompatible answers serving different remedies are gold for the research (2026-11-05))
- 2026-11-05 · touches · "This links back to decisions in context." (Owner: explain a technical decision's strategic consequences, not its specifics (2026-11-05))
- 2026-11-05 · touches · "decision checklist. It will need to be reviewed often for a while." (Owner: a place where we manage our decision checklist, reviewed often for a while (2026-11-05))
- 2026-11-07 · touches · "SRS and srs-rust should have a set of decision logs" (Map the muSrs sources; the Systemic Data Ethics 4x3 map classified standards and GDPR; axes may work best on decisions, and srs and srs-rust have decision logs (2026-11-07))
